certified_object.definition: Draw a flow uniformly at random from the service; then draw one cell from that flow's normalized 32-cell PHIST distribution.
certified_object.law_type: categorical distribution over the 32 PHIST cells
certified_object.not_bound: the continuous-support law of per-flow normalized vectors

confidence.lower_side_guarantee: Michel et al. asymptotic high-probability lower bound; not an exact finite-sample certificate
confidence.split_convention: alpha/2 = 0.025 is allocated to each law for the upper side; the lower side is called with alpha=0.025
confidence.upper_side_guarantee: finite-sample, distribution-free, simultaneous per-law coordinate Hoeffding plus union bound

ks_type_bound.caveat: No KS-type classifier-score bound is used in this run.

lower_side.guarantee: asymptotic HPLB, not an exact finite-sample guarantee; it is not labeled finite-sample certified
lower_side.input_unit: one independently sampled cell per uniformly retained flow, passed as a 32-column one-hot matrix; never the per-flow 32-vector matrix

routine_execution_report.purpose: read-only schema, service counts, normalized flow means, and tv_hat
fixed-seed uniform per-service retained flow samples
one categorical cell draw per retained flow for the lower side
Michel lower bound; marked true as each pair is processed
per-row invariant, quantiles, fraction, and top-pair report
